entities.name: Mustafa Mujezinović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mustafa Mujezinović was a Bosnian politician and diplomat who served as Prime Minister of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina from 2009 to 2011. He also served as Governor of Sarajevo Canton from 1998 to 2000, and previously as Prime Minister of Sarajevo Canton from 1996 to 1998.
